meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.citation: The Company currently expects to invest approximately $105 million to $115 million into its portfolio in 2026, with a majority of the investment related to the previously completed renovation of the meeting space at Hilton San Diego Bayfront, renovation work at Hilton Key West Resort & Marina, storm-related restoration work at Wailea Beach Resort, and various other projects across the remaining hotels in the portfolio.

guidances.libelle: Full year interest and other income
guidances.citation: Full year interest and other income (excluding amounts received from our insurance programs as reimbursement for restoration of property damage) of approximately $7 million to $8 million. This range is unchanged from the Company’s prior estimate.

Full year corporate overhead expense (excluding deferred stock amortization and management transition costs) of approximately $19 million. This estimate is $0.5 million lower than the midpoint of the Company’s prior range.

Full year interest expense of approximately $46 million to $49 million, including approximately $4 million in amortization of deferred financing costs and $7 million of noncash reduction to interest expense on derivatives. Excluding the noncash interest on derivatives, this range is unchanged from the Company’s prior estimate.

Full year preferred stock dividends of approximately $15 million, which includes the Series G, H, and I cumulative redeemable preferred stock. This estimate is $0.5 million lower than the midpoint of the Company’s prior range.
